驾.def: to drive, to ride, to sail; carriage, cart

origin.says: Simplified from 駕: 馬 (horse) became 马. 加 (add, attach) as the sound plus 马 (horse) for the meaning: attaching a horse to a cart, 'to yoke, to drive'.

驾.name: harness

ety.hint: A person's 亻 duty 责; 责 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 債: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 責 (to demand) as the sound: what a person owes, a debt. 責 was shortened to 责.
欠 (open mouth, breathing out) for the meaning plus 斤 (axe) as the sound: a happy breath, delight.
雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 彗 (broom) as the sound, later cut to 彐: snow, which is swept away; hence also to wipe away shame.

遵.def: to follow, to comply with; to honor

ety.hint: To follow 辶 or honor 尊 someone; 尊 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 尊 (honor) as the sound, which also hints at respect: to walk along with, to follow and obey.

遵.name: obey

碰.def: to touch; to meet with; to collide, to bump into

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 並 (side by side) as the sound: to knock against, to bump into; a late, colloquial character.

碰.name: bump

咨.def: to inquire, to consult, to discuss; to plan

origin.says: 次 (next) as the sound plus 口 (mouth) for the meaning: to ask, to consult, to talk things over.

咨.name: consult

敦.def: honest, candid, sincere; kind-hearted; to esteem

origin.says: Built from 𦎫 (a shrine with a sheep: a cooked offering) as the sound plus 攵 (hand with a stick), first 'to press'. 𦎫 lost its sheep and now looks like 享 (to enjoy); later 'sincere, honest'.

敦.name: honest

ety.hint: A woman 女 standing by her master's right hand 又; 女 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 女 (woman) plus 又 (hand): a hand seizing a woman, a captive put to work, a slave. 女 may also give the sound.
火 (fire) added to 然 (so), which first meant burn and is also the sound: the fire was added once 然 had been borrowed for other meanings. It means to burn, to ignite.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 谷 (valley) as the sound: the ways of ordinary people, customs, and so common or vulgar.
口 (mouth, marking a sound-only character) plus 非 as the sound: a modern character made to write 'fee' in 'coffee' and in 'morphine'.
金 (metal) for the meaning plus 監 (to look over) as the sound: a metal basin or mirror you look into. The simplified form keeps only the top of 监 (look over) above 金 (metal).

ety.hint: To want 我 food 饣; 我 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 餓: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 我 (I) as the sound: hungry. 食 is written in its short side form 饣.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 广 as the sound: ore, a mine. Simplified from 礦, whose sound part 廣 (wide) was cut down to 广.

ety.hint: An eye 目 peering from behind a shield 厂

origin.says: First a drawing of a shield; the modern shape reads as a cover 𠂆 over 十 (ten) and 目 (eye), like an eye peering out behind a shield.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 及 (reach) as the sound: dirt and debris, now used in 垃圾 (rubbish).
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 立 (stand) as the sound: dirt, rubbish (as in 垃圾, garbage).

搬.def: to move, to remove, to shift, to transfer

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 般 (kind) as the sound: moving things by hand, 'to move, to relocate'.

搬.name: move house

ety.hint: The plots of a rice paddy

origin.says: A drawing of a field divided into four plots by paths.

田.name: field
田.in: 界备男思播留副略富画细福谓翻逼描奋累幅猫衡戴雷番翼苗喂辐亩鼻畴瞄胃兽瘤畜畏蓄溜畔惫僵榴潘疆舅蕾痹骡佃甸偎甥猬畸锚腮馏蝠擂

origin.says: 口 (mouth) plus 加 (add) as the sound: a character made to write foreign sounds, here the 'ca' of 'coffee'. The 口 marks it as a sound-only character.
每 (every) as the sound plus 攵 (hand with a stick, action) for the meaning: quick in action, nimble, clever.

陪.def: to accompany, to be with, to keep company

origin.says: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 咅 (spit) as the sound: earth piled up beside, hence 'to be alongside, to accompany'.

陪.name: accompany

愈.def: to recover, to heal; more and more

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: to feel better, to heal; also 'more and more'. It now also stands for 癒 (cure).

愈.name: healing heart

ety.hint: A dog 犬 watching in the dark 黑

origin.says: 黑 (black) as the sound plus 犬 (dog) for the meaning: first a dog that follows people silently, then silent, still.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: the dewlap hanging under an animal's chin; then northern nomads and 'reckless'. The simplified form also stands for 鬍 (beard) and 衚 (lane).

跃.def: to skip, to jump, to frolic

origin.says: Simplified from 躍: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 翟 (pheasant) as the sound. The simplified form replaces the sound part with 夭 (young, bending): to leap or jump.

跃.name: leap

origin.says: 叀 (spindle) as the sound plus 心 (heart): a kind heart, hence favour and kindness.

吹.def: to blow, to puff; to brag, to boast

origin.says: 口 (mouth) plus 欠 (person with open mouth): to blow out air; later also to brag. One source reads 欠 as the sound.

吹.name: blow

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound: to dress up, make up, play a part.

舒.def: relaxed, comfortable; to unfold, to stretch out

origin.says: 舍 (house, to rest) for the meaning plus 予 (give) as the sound: to stretch out, at ease, comfortable.

舒.name: stretch out

origin.says: A drawing of a hand with claws or nails, borrowed for an earthly branch (the ox hour). The simplification also made it write the unrelated, same-sounding 醜 (ugly: 酉 sound + 鬼 demon).
Simplified from 懼: 忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 瞿 (startled gaze) as the sound: to fear. The sound part was replaced by the simpler 具 (tool), an old variant.

奏.def: to play; to memorialize; to report

ety.hint: A report about (above) the emperor 天

origin.says: Two hands holding up an object, perhaps an instrument offered in a ritual (another reading: hands collecting tree resin). The parts merged so the build is no longer visible: to present, to play music.

奏.name: play music

origin.says: A drawing of teeth: bronze forms show upper and lower molars fitting together (one reading: a pair of tusks). It first meant the back teeth, later teeth in general.

月 (flesh) for the meaning with a second part now written 巴: plenty of flesh, fat; hence fertile. One reading takes that part as a kneeling person, another as a shortened sound part; the modern 巴 is a shape only.

腊.def: December; year's end sacrifice; dried meat

ety.hint: A sacrifice of meat ⺼ for the past year 昔

origin.says: Two characters merged: 腊 (xī, dried meat), ⺼ (meat) plus 昔 (old, dried) as the sound, was taken over for 臘 (là, the year-end sacrifice, ⺼ + 巤 as the sound). Hence December and cured meat.

腊.name: cured meat

隔.def: to separate, to partition, to divide

origin.says: 阝 (mound, wall) for the meaning plus 鬲 (cauldron) as the sound: to separate with a wall.

隔.name: partition wall

origin.says: 倝 (sun rising) as the sound plus 羽 (feather) for the meaning: a long feather, used as a brush, hence writing brush and writing. The 人 (person) of 倝 sits above 羽.

覆.def: to cover; to overturn; to repeat; to reply

origin.says: 襾 (a cover, written 覀) for the meaning plus 復 (to return) as the sound: to cover over, and to turn over.

覆.name: overturn

返.def: to restore, to return, to revert to

ety.hint: To walk 辶 backwards 反; 反 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 反 (turn back) as the sound and meaning: to walk back, to return.

返.name: go back

揭.def: to lift off a cover; to reveal, to divulge; surname

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound: to lift up by hand, to lift off a cover, to reveal.

揭.name: lift off

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 朝 (morning) as the sound and meaning: the morning rise of the sea, the tide; then damp.

牺.def: to sacrifice, to give up, to die for a cause

origin.says: From 犧: 牛 (ox) for the meaning plus 羲 (a legendary name) as the sound, an animal offered in sacrifice. The simplified form swaps the complex sound part for 西 (west).

牺.name: sacrifice

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 庄 (village) as the sound. It stands for two traditional characters: 臟 (internal organ) and 髒 (dirty), each with a different sound part.

莫.def: cannot; do not; is not; negative

origin.says: A drawing of the sun 日 (sun) sinking among plants above and below: dusk, now written 暮 (dusk). The lower plants were later distorted into 大 (big). 'Do not' is a sound loan.

莫.name: don't
莫.in: 模幕摸漠寞墓慕膜募暮馍摹蟆

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 正 (upright) as the sound: a disease, its signs. It replaced 癥, which had 徵 (sign) as the sound part.
宀 (roof) over linked rooms, drawn as two boxes like 吕: a large house with many rooms, a palace. One source takes 吕 as the sound instead.
Simplified from 飾: 飤 (to feed) as the sound plus 巾 (cloth) for the meaning, cloth for wiping and adorning. The 人 (person) of 飤 has become 𠂉, and 食 (food) became 饣.

罢.def: to cease, to finish, to stop, to quit

ety.hint: Stuck in a net 罒, unable to leave 去

origin.says: Traditional 罷 is 罒 (net) plus 能 (bear, able): a bear caught in a net, worn out and stopped, to cease. The simplified form replaced 能 with 去 (go away).

罢.name: quit

origin.says: Simplified from 鮮: 鱼 (fish) plus 羊 (sheep), first a kind of fish, then fresh fish and meat, fresh. One reading takes 羊 as short for a sound part, another as 'fish and mutton, tasty'.

ety.hint: A spear pointed up and to the right

origin.says: A drawing of a spear with a long shaft and a ring or tassel on it: spear, lance.

ety.hint: A storm 雨 over the fields 田

origin.says: An old shortening of 靁: 雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 畾 (rolling drums, wheels) as the sound, cut down to one 田. Thunder rolls in the storm.
囗 (enclosure) added around 员 (member), which gives the sound and once itself meant 'round': a circle, round, complete. Simplified from 圓 (員 to 员).

凭.def: to lean on; to rely on

ety.hint: Leaning on (trusting) 任 a table 几

origin.says: An old character, 任 (to bear, trust) plus 几 (stool, small table): to lean on a table, hence to rely on. It took over the traditional 憑, built from 馮 as the sound and 心 (heart).

凭.name: rely

荷.def: lotus, water lily; burden, responsibility; Holland

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 何 (what) as the sound: the lotus. The sense 'burden' comes from 何, which once meant to carry on the shoulder.

荷.name: lotus

撑.def: to support, to prop up, to brace; overflowing

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus a sound part: to prop up, brace. The traditional 撐 used 牚 (a prop) as the sound; the simplified form replaced it with 掌 (palm).

撑.name: brace

origin.says: Simplified from 劉: 卯 (sound) plus 金 (metal) and 刂 (knife), a battle-axe, to kill; now mainly the surname Liu. The left side was replaced by the simpler 文 (writing), only a placeholder.

愤.def: anger, indignation; to hate, to resent

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 贲 (bright, ornate) as the sound: anger welling up in the heart. Simplified from 憤.

愤.name: indignant

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 某 (a certain) as the sound: the black stuff that burns, soot and then coal.
酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 告 (tell) as the sound: a strong, harsh drink, hence intense and cruel; today also 'cool'.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 夜 (night) as the sound: a liquid, juice, sap.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 冬 (winter) as the sound: pain, ache; also to love dearly.

剥.def: to peel, to skin; to exploit

origin.says: 录 (record), a form of 彔, as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to peel or skin, and to strip someone of goods. Simplified from 剝.

剥.name: peel

绘.def: to sketch, to paint, to draw

origin.says: Simplified from 繪: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 会 (meet) as the sound: colours brought together on silk, to paint or draw.

绘.name: paint

削.def: to pare, to scrape, to trim

origin.says: 肖 (likeness) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to pare, to shave off with a knife.

削.name: pare

拖.def: to drag, to haul, to tow; to delay

origin.says: A variant of 拕: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 它 (snake, it) as the sound: to drag or haul. Here the sound part is written in the variant shape 㐌.

拖.name: drag

歧.def: to diverge, to fork; a branch; a side road

origin.says: 止 (foot) for the meaning plus 支 (branch) as the sound: a road that branches, to diverge.

歧.name: fork road

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 于 (at) as the sound: a sigh, 'alas'. As a simplified form it also writes the unrelated 籲 (to appeal, call for).
口 (mouth) plus a sound part, made to write the borrowed word 'ton'. The full form 噸 used 頓 as the sound; the simplified form uses the shorter 屯 instead.
A picture of a hard protective shell or plated armour. It is also the first of the ten heavenly stems, so 'first, grade A'.

ety.hint: A person 亻 keeping watch over a child 子; 子 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 子 (child) as the sound and hint: a young one, a small thing.

仿.def: to imitate, to copy; fake; as if

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: to be like someone, to imitate. It also replaces the traditional 彷.

仿.name: imitate

屁.def: to break wind, to fart; the buttocks

origin.says: 尸 (body) for the meaning plus 比 (compare) as the sound: to break wind, a fart.

屁.name: fart

恨.def: to dislike, to hate, to resent

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: a feeling of hatred, resentment.

恨.name: hatred

origin.says: A drawing of a knife, its blade and handle: knife.

刀.name: knife
刀.in: 分解照超切初份绍召招彻粉贫纷颁扮氛券剪窃契盼盆蟹沼吩芬劈掰懈砌叨岔寡忿迢昭

origin.says: Simplified from 鄰: 粦 (will-o'-the-wisp) as the sound plus 阝 (town) for the meaning, households close together. The simplified form uses 令 (command) as the new sound part.
鬼 (ghost) for the meaning plus 云 (cloud) as the sound, perhaps also hinting at a cloud-like breath: the soul.
